title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 9.2 Solve Money Applications: Solve coin word problems
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 9.2 Solve Money Applications: Solve coin word problems
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "9.2 Solve Money Applications", prints these objectives: "Solve coin word problems" "Solve ticket and stamp word problems". The section text says: "Imagine taking a handful of coins from your pocket or purse and placing them on your desk. How would you determine the value of that pile of coins?" This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
